method_note: 20 officers at the average cost of the Law Enforcement Team, which costs £4.6m a year for 72 officers

Half of the £2.1m the council budgeted in 2025/26 to collect household rubbish (not recycling or food waste), told to us in a Freedom of Information answer on 27 October 2026 (reference 27548393). Collecting fortnightly would roughly halve the rounds; the real saving is likely smaller, as recycling usually rises. The council says it has never estimated the saving.
